content.comment_body: Hi [user_name], Sorry, my first message was posted in the German forum. Here is an image for further clarification.

Hello. Some of the input ports on [product_name] modules with [version_no] have dual functionality: they can be set up as either digital or analog inputs. It's possible that your analog input is currently configured as digital. Best regards.

analysis.insight_summary: The feedback explains that some input connections on [product_name] modules with [version_no] offer both digital and analog input options. This can cause users to mistakenly configure an analog input as digital, leading to unexpected behavior. Without straightforward instructions, setting the desired input type may be confusing for some users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping for clearer instructions and more intuitive options to distinguish and assign module inputs as either analog or digital.
